title: (RHBA-2019:3904) Update to Fuse 7.5.0 fuse-camel-k image
portal_summary: Red Hat Fuse 7.5.0 update of 'Fuse Camel-K' image.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on Camel-K image (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.5 on OpenShift, see the
following section of the Fuse on OpenShift Guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.5/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/#patch-images

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.5 Online, see the following
section of the Integrating Applications with Fuse Online guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.5/html/integrating_applications_with_fuse_online/fuse-online-on-ocp_ug#upgrade-on-ocp_ocp
portal_description: This advisory makes available an update to the image for Fuse Camel-K for Red Hat Fuse 7.5.0.
abstract: This advisory makes available an update to the image for Fuse Camel-K for Red Hat Fuse 7.5.0.
